description: A grid sequencer: each column is a step, each row a note, and the notes turned on in the column now playing are sent out together

params.text: Sets how many columns play before the sequence starts over, marked by the purple line
Sets the direction the sequence travels through its columns
Sends the sequence back to its first column
Turns every cell in the grid off

Turns the grid a quarter turn anticlockwise
Flips the grid left to right
Flips the grid top to bottom
Moves every cell up by the number of rows the AMOUNT knob is set to, wrapping round to the bottom
Moves every cell down by the number of rows the AMOUNT knob is set to, wrapping round to the top
Runs Conway's game of life over the grid, so the pattern breeds and dies on its own
Sets how many clock ticks pass between one generation of the game of life and the next
Sets the scale the pitch output is quantised to; the last setting leaves the pitch alone
Sets the root note the pitch output is quantised to
Shifts the pitch output by whole octaves, -5 to +7
Sets the orange line, above which notes are left out of the outputs
Sets the yellow line, below which notes are left out of the outputs
To the right the outputs line up with the sixteen lowest rows whether or not a cell is on, which suits drum parts; to the left they carry the sixteen lowest notes actually turned on
Sets how many rows a shift moves the cells

Moves every cell in a direction of its own, by the number of rows the AMOUNT knob is set to

notes: click a cell in the grid to turn it on or off, and drag across the grid to paint a run of them
menu: Polyphony channels — sets how many channels the polyphonic pitch and gate outputs carry
Repeat 16 Steps — copies the first sixteen columns across the rest of the grid
Gate Mode — sets what the gate outputs do: Trigger fires a short pulse, Retrigger drops the gate for a moment before each new step, Continuous holds it until the next clock tick
Gate Length — sets how long a Trigger or Retrigger gate lasts, in milliseconds
